sre_alex: Heads up — saw a ~3x spike in synthetic probe failures for streaming endpoints in us-west1 at 23:10 UTC. Looks correlated with spot preemptions on gpu-pool-spot-1.
prod_monitor_bot: ALERT: synthetic_probe_failure_rate (job=blackbox_inference) > 1% for 5m · firing · affected: /v1/stream -> 503/timeout count up.
infra_maya: Yup, cluster autoscaler logs show a bunch of preempt events and node deletions between 23:07-23:12. Preemptible GPU pool got reclaimed.
mlops_ravi: Are we losing KV cache on pod restart? That would explain handshake timeouts for streams (warmup -> 503).
oncall_jamie: Oncall saw rapid alert churn too. Pager fired twice in 8m. Need to reduce noise.
sre_alex: Root cause summary: spot preemptions -> pod churn -> streaming handshakes failing while GPUs reinitialize -> blackbox probes mark as failures. But alerts are noisy because of short bursts.
infra_maya: Two tradeoffs: keep spot pools for cost, but accept more transient failures; or reserve a tiny non-preemptible canary pool to stabilize probes. Cost impact is ~+6% infra for a small pinned pool.
mlops_ravi: We can also split probes into two tiers: lightweight TCP/handshake probe (cheap, frequent) + full streaming probe (heavy, less frequent). That should lower alert sensitivity.
sre_alex: Agree. Also thinking of changing Prometheus recording rules: compute a smoothed probe success ratio using `avg_over_time` and alert on sustained drop over 10m instead of 5m.
oncall_jamie: +1 for longer window. Also suggest Alertmanager grouping/silences during rolling node deletions via kube events integration.
mlops_ravi: Practical changes I can do: (1) reduce full-stream probe rate from 1/min -> 1/3min; (2) implement two-step probe logic in probe-runner; (3) add jitter to probe schedule to avoid synchronized spikes. I'll open PRs.
infra_maya: I'll prototype a tiny 2x GPU pinned canary pool for probes only and run for 24h to measure baseline. If ok, we'll request the cost bump.
sre_alex: For Prometheus, I'll propose a recording rule: `probe_stream_success_ratio_10m = avg_over_time(probe_success{check="stream"}[10m])` and change alert to `probe_stream_success_ratio_10m < 0.99 for 5m`. That converts instantaneous noise to sustained drop.
prod_monitor_bot: NOTE: added annotation ticket #INC-4521 to track action items.
oncall_jamie: Runbook needs update: add steps to correlate preempt events (`kubectl get events --field-selector reason=PreemptibleEviction`) and a quick mitigation (pause heavy probes + restart probe-runner on stable nodes). I'll draft.
sre_alex: TL;DR action items: infra_maya -> experiment pinned canary pool; mlops_ravi -> split probes + reduce rate + jitter (PRs referenced in thread); sre_alex -> recording rule + alert change proposal; oncall_jamie -> update runbook.
mlops_ravi: One extra note on evaluation: include `node_pool_type` label in probe metrics so we can attribute failures to spot vs pinned pools. I'll add that to probe payload.
infra_maya: Good idea. Also add `preempt_count` from cluster autoscaler as metric so we can correlate.
sre_alex: Okay folks, let's aim to have PRs + experiment live by EOD tomorrow. If anyone sees more noisy alerts in the meantime, put a silence on the alert with reason "spot-churn" for up to 2h. :thumbsup:
